Description: GuardDuty detectors do not have EKS Runtime Monitoring enabled. This feature provides runtime threat detection for EKS nodes and containers.
Risk: Without EKS Runtime Monitoring, potentially compromised EKS clusters could remain unnoticed, along with attempts to perform privilege escalation within the environment.

Recommendation.Text: Consider enabling EKS Runtime Monitoring on GuardDuty detectors, across all accounts and regions, enforcing the principle of least privilege on monitoring results.
